invariants: Acceptance predicates are stated before implementation.
Architecture work is conditional on uncertainty and risk.
Completion claims use VERIFIED, NOT VERIFIED, or INCONCLUSIVE.
Localized work finishes without a formal plan or phase task structure.
The reported symptom is reproduced before a root-cause claim.
The original surface is rerun after the fix.
Speculative changes are removed when evidence rejects them.
Tests are not deleted, skipped, or loosened to make the fix pass.
Neither implementation nor tests are treated as automatic behavioral truth.
Corrections cite requirements, contracts, prior verified behavior, or explicit uncertainty.
Ambiguous expectations remain INCONCLUSIVE until resolved.
Every automatic test edit is listed in the final report.
Project checks are discovered rather than guessed.
Push and pull-request creation require explicit user intent.
The lead reproduces the symptom before spawning investigators.
Only the lead edits product code.
Codex runs the standard fix flow and does not claim peer-to-peer agent messaging.
